observations: Photo 0: a complete car engine lying on a concrete floor, shot from above at an angle.
Large black plastic intake manifold with long runners on top, typical of a V6 or V8 petrol engine.
A long gearbox appears bolted to the back of the engine (upper left), so it looks like an engine and transmission together, rear-wheel-drive layout.
Wiring harness, hoses and fuel lines still attached; dust and dirt around it, a steel wheel rim in the corner.
Watermark 'T.I AUTOMOBILE' across the photo; this is the seller's mark, not the engine maker.
No brand badge, engine code, or engine number plate is readable anywhere in the photo.
No sign of whether it turns over or runs; no oil, compression or test evidence.

identity.kind: used car petrol engine with gearbox (V-type)

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a used engine but nothing proves it was imported directly and never used locally; no import papers, tags or engine number shown.

risks.risk: Make and engine code unknown, and these set the price; a V6 and a V8 from different makers differ greatly.
risks.proof: Close photo of the engine code and engine number stamped on the block, plus any maker logo on the covers.

risks.risk: Engine may not run, may have low compression, knocking or a seized bottom end.
risks.proof: Clip of the engine on a test stand or in a car, started from cold, with sound and a compression gauge reading per cylinder.

risks.risk: The attached gearbox may be faulty or may not be included in the sale.
risks.proof: Clip of the gearbox engaging gears on a running test, and a written confirmation the gearbox is part of the lot.
risks.if_unproven: as engine only, gearbox not counted

risks.risk: Missing or broken ancillaries such as alternator, starter, ECU, sensors or harness.
risks.proof: Photos of all four sides of the engine showing alternator, starter, AC pump and the ECU if included.
risks.if_unproven: as a bare engine without ancillaries or ECU

proof_requests: Close photo of the engine code and serial number stamped on the block, and any maker badge.
Cold start clip with sound, showing no smoke and no knocking.
Photos of all four sides of the engine and gearbox.
Confirmation of what is included: gearbox, ECU, alternator, starter, harness.
response.reason: It is clearly a used car engine with gearbox, but the make and engine code that set its price are not readable in photo 0, so not even a worst case price can be found until the engine code is shown.
